cn.t: Margulies' Chekhov-inspired family drama earns mixed reviews, with critics finding it pleasant but derivative and predictable. Blythe Danner's performance wins consistent praise, though the play itself is deemed mediocre and overshadowed by Durang's recent Vanya riff.
